text:
```yaml
name: PR Title Check

on:
  pull_request:
    types: [opened, edited, reopened, synchronize]

jobs:
  check-title:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Check PR title format
        uses: actions/github-script@v6
        with:
          script: |
            const title = context.payload.pull_request.title;
            const regex = /^\([A-Z]+\) .+ \[\d+\]$/;
            if (!regex.test(title)) {
              core.setFailed(`PR title "${title}" does not match required format "(TYPE) description [TASK-ID]"`);
            }
```
